source: TO-BE-MEASURED: the token-privileged reference (solution/solve.sh writes the grader's truth) through the pinned engine, ale validate on the final tree.
reference_commit: the commit that regenerates the logs of tasks/ground/multisensor_rig_calibration_from_logs
note: The reference is privileged, not a calibrator: its score is the score of the true parameters on the six fixed hidden rigs (1.0 on each: every full point is several times what the truth leaves on the held-out drive). No unprivileged reference is run or judged; the author's first calibrator is kept in tests/review/ as review material.
